doc.description: Fast controller for MAV group 12 (cmjong). Receives left/middle/right loss values from MAV_cv_detect_group12_cmjong plus an obstacle-ahead flag from Luke optical flow, and navigates using a state machine: SAFE_AND_WAIT, TURN_TO_LOWEST_LOSS, MOVE_FORWARD_WITH_FIXED_DISTANCE, OUT_OF_BOUNDS.

define.name: MAV_cmjong_OF_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
